title: Repo visualizer of my dev environment tool is a terraforming game. Trees/leaves/animals are folders/code/big assets. Buildings/robots are orchestrators/executors. Accounts power them with beams of light.
author: Olmeca_Gold

comments.author: Olmeca_Gold
comments.body:
Here is a dashboard visualizing the development of my game repo as a terraforming project.

This is the development history of Shatterwake (my MMO). In Ludocraft (my gamedev environment), I can check the situation of my game's development by looking at a single strategy game map.

- Buildings are game domain orchestrators.
- Robots are executors.
- Trees are folders. Leaves are code.
- Animals are 3d models and large asset files (not super visible in the film).
- Orchestrators dispatch executors, send tickets to the command center (me). Command center visualizes waiting tickets.
- Power center (accounts) power orchestrators and executors with beams.
